title: The Gatekeeping Expert's Dilemma
abstract: arXiv:2511.00031v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies how experts with veto power---gatekeeping experts---influence agents through communication. Their expertise informs agents' decisions, while veto power provides discipline. Gatekeepers face a dilemma: transparent communication can invite gaming, while opacity wastes expertise. How can gatekeeping experts guide behavior without being gamed? Many economic settings feature this tradeoff, including bank stress tests, environmental regulations, and financial auditing. Using financial auditing as the primary setting, I show that strategic vagueness resolves this dilemma: by revealing just enough to prevent the manager from inflating the report, the auditor guides the manager while minimizing opportunities for manipulation. This theoretical lens provides a novel rationale for why auditors predominantly accept clients' financial reports. Comparative statics reveal that greater gatekeeper independence or expertise sometimes

translated_abstract: 本文研究拥有否决权的专家——即“守门专家”——如何通过沟通来影响代理人。他们的专业知识为代理人的决策提供信息，而否决权则提供纪律约束。守门专家面临一个两难困境：透明的沟通可能招致博弈操纵，而不透明则会浪费专业知识。守门专家如何在不被操纵的情况下引导行为？许多经济环境中都存在这种权衡，包括银行压力测试、环境监管和财务审计。本文以财务审计为主要情境，证明策略性模糊可以化解这一困境：审计师只需透露足够的信息以防止经理夸大报告，就能在引导经理的同时将操纵机会降至最低。这一理论视角为审计师为何大多接受客户的财务报告提供了一个新颖的解释。比较静态分析表明，守门专家更高的独立性或专业知识有时……
tldr: 本文提出“策略性模糊”机制可以化解守门专家（如审计师）在透明沟通与被操纵之间的两难，并为审计师为何大多接受客户财务报告提供了新的理论解释。
